title: Assisted evaluation of aniline's in silico toxicity using artificial intelligence and its simultaneous determination as a toxic impurity with widely used cardiovascular drugs using a green micellar chromatographic method
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9563-9577
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09502F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alaa Ahmed Mostafa, Soad S. Abd El-Hay, Youstina Mekhail Metias, Mohamed Adel Said, Michael Gamal Fawzy
An eco-friendly micellar HPLC method, integrated with an AI-assisted docking approach, enables the simultaneous determination of aniline and salicylic acid impurities with four cardiovascular drugs, to predict aniline toxicity.
